Name: Prismatic Fire - Continued
Author: recon88
Description:
[size=5]Overview[/size]
[size=2]This mod allows you to change the fire color of fireplaces, campfires and torches.
The mod itself only adds the framework/functionality and requires at least one Content Patcher pack to work.
Example: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30818/]Prismatic Fire - Continued - Gems and Minerals (CP)[/url]


[/size][size=5]Use[/size][size=2]
Simply rightclick a fire with an item to change the fire's color.
By default, the item will be consumed. This can be turned off by changing [i]IsItemConsumed[/i] to [i]false.
[/i]Turning back fire to its default color is done by clicking it with the item configured at [i]ResetItemId[/i]. Default is 388 (Wood).


[/size][size=5]Config[/size]
[code]{
  "ModEnabled": true,
  "IsItemConsumed": true,
  "TriggerSound": "fireball",
  "ResetItemId": "388"
}
[/code]

[size=5]Requirements
[/size]At least one Content Patcher pack, for example [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30818/]Prismatic Fire - Continued - Gems and Minerals (CP)[/url]
You can also click on [b]Requirements [/b]->[b] Mods requiring this file [/b]above to see a list of available packs.


[size=5]COMPATIBILITY[/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later[/size]
[*][size=2]Generic Mod Config Menu[/size]
[/list]

Downloads.Description: Added ResetItemId (388 = Wood) to config which allows you to set an item ID that turn the fire back to default.
